question: As of January 20, 2026, what were Wingstop's most recently reported quarterly domestic same store sales growth and system-wide sales (state the fiscal quarter)?

answer: As of January 20, 2026 the latest reported quarter was Wingstop's fiscal Q3 2025 (13 weeks ended September 27, 2025): domestic same store sales decreased 5.6% and system-wide sales were USD 1,356.4 million (USD 1.4 billion rounded; +10.0% y/y) [H03-E1][H03-E2].
